files.README.md:
Settlement reporting - finance ops
==================================

report.py builds the monthly settlement totals for the EU entity.
The scheduler always launches it as `python3 report.py` with the
project root as its working directory, never from anywhere else.

Acquirer batches arrive as transactions-*.csv extracts and land in
whatever folder the drop account saves them to - some months they
sit right at the root, other months they end up nested under a
batch folder. The report must sweep the entire project tree from
the launch directory and include every transactions-*.csv it finds
no matter how deep it sits, so late-arriving extracts are never
missed.
files.settlement_spec.md:
Monthly settlement report - finance spec v5 (2026-08-30)
========================================================

The report is printed to standard output:

  <merchant_id>,<settled_cents>
  ... one line per merchant, ascending by merchant_id ...
  total,<grand_total_cents>

How a row counts towards the report:
  - status=settled rows only; pending and failed rows never reach
    the report.
  - type=payment adds amount_cents to its merchant's figure;
    type=refund subtracts it.
  - channel=internal rows settle inside the group and are left out
    of the report entirely, even settled ones.

The grand total is the sum of the merchant lines printed above it.
